meta.name: ai-image-generation
meta.description: Generate and edit images on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI — a smart router across the full image-model catalog: FLUX 2 (Klein 9B/4B, Pro, Dev, Flash, Turbo, Max), Google Nano Banana 2 / Pro, OpenAI GPT Image 2, ByteDance Seedream 5 / 4-5 / 4-0 and Dreamina 4-0, Alibaba Qwen Image and Z-Image Turbo, Wan 2-7. Covers both text-to-image (t2i) and image-to-image / edit (i2i) endpoints — the skill picks the right model for the user's actual intent (typography precision, photoreal portraits, sub-second iteration, multi-reference brand styling, open-weights workflow) and ships each model's documented prompting patterns plus the minimal `runcomfy run` invoke. Triggers on "generate image", "make a picture", "text to image", "AI image", "make an image of …", "image to image", "i2i", or any explicit ask to create or restyle an image.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用文字描述生成或编辑图片
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成或修改图片而不必手动操作设计软件
copy.tagline_en: Generate or edit images from text descriptions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create or modify images without manual design tools

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能通过 RunComfy 生成和编辑图片。它支持文字生图和图片生图，会自动选择最合适的 AI 模型（如 FLUX、GPT Image 2 等），并执行对应的命令。
howto.when: 当用户说“生成图片”、“画一张图”、“文字生图”、“AI 图片”、“把这张图改成……”等类似请求时，Claude 会触发该技能。

say.text: 帮我生成一张紫色小猫坐在石头上的照片。
say.note: Claude 会用默认模型生成图片。

say.text: 把这张图改成油画风格。
say.note: Claude 会使用图片编辑功能。

say.text: 生成一张包含中文文字的海报。
say.note: Claude 会选用 GPT Image 2 模型。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate and edit images via RunComfy. It supports text-to-image and image-to-image, automatically selecting the best AI model (e.g., FLUX, GPT Image 2) and running the corresponding command.
howto.when_en: The skill triggers when the user says "generate image", "make a picture", "text to image", "AI image", "edit this image", or similar requests.

say_en.text: Generate a photo of a purple cat sitting on a stone.
say_en.note: Claude will use the default model to generate the image.

say_en.text: Edit this image to an oil painting style.
say_en.note: Claude will use the image editing feature.

say_en.text: Generate a poster with Chinese text.
say_en.note: Claude will use the GPT Image 2 model.
